summary: The current tree already contains lifecycle usage plumbing, but the proposed sdd-coder path does not yet connect Google-compatible clients, failed-attempt usage, or estimate-vs-provider accounting. The main risks are metadata loss through display-oriented dispatch events, privacy leakage from existing error fields, and deriving durable task-size data from ephemeral worktrees.

suggestions.title: Persist admission estimates in BudgetReport
suggestions.rationale: QuestionBudget retains estimates only inside reservations, while _report_locked() exposes settled provider usage. Therefore scope.ledger.report() cannot show how far tiktoken admission differed from provider counts. Add explicit estimated input/admission totals, with clear treatment of released, uncertain, and settled reservations, before using the report as the calibration signal.

suggestions.title: Implement a budget adapter for google-compat or narrow the seat claim
suggestions.rationale: GeminiOpenAICompatClient only subclasses OpenAIBaseClient and does not define budget_supported_methods or budget_adapter_factory; the base defaults leave both empty/None. OpenAIBaseClient therefore bypasses the budgeted funnel for the Google dispatcher, so the same instrumentation currently covers Nova but not google-compat.

suggestions.title: Define a typed transport for per-turn and budget metadata
suggestions.rationale: _completion_usage_payload() returns arbitrary dictionary keys, but action_from_dispatch_event() copies only the existing scalar fields into DispatchCompleted. The proposed per-turn series and BudgetReport would be discarded before AttemptTelemetryCollector.apply() sees them. Either add bounded, optional typed fields and explicit mapping to DispatchCompleted, or use a separate telemetry callback; do not rely on unknown payload keys surviving the session-state projection.

suggestions.title: Make failed dispatches carry partial usage exactly once
suggestions.rationale: LLMCodeDispatcher publishes dispatch.failed with error metadata only, while AttemptTelemetryCollector records usage only from DispatchCompleted. The awaited AfterClientCallEvent is emitted through a client registry, but SddCoderEngine does not wire a per-run lifecycle registry for its newly built dispatchers; ClientCallFailedEvent also has no token fields. A failed coding attempt can therefore lose all tokens burned before the exception. Add a terminal failure usage payload or an explicit collector callback, and define deduplication if both lifecycle and dispatch paths are enabled.

suggestions.title: Project privacy-safe rows instead of serializing AttemptRecord
suggestions.rationale: AttemptRecord.error is populated with the full exception string, and the engine's diagnostics also preserve raw exception/merge text. Serializing the existing record wholesale into JSONL can capture paths, provider messages, tool details, or other content despite the counters-only requirement. Build a strict allowlisted telemetry row containing identifiers, counts, timings, status, and exception class only; never dump error or diagnostics fields into the dataset.

suggestions.title: Make the durable telemetry root explicit and feature filenames safe
suggestions.rationale: SddCoderEngine currently receives a feature worktree/base path and its only persistence helper writes beneath that worktree. It has no explicit main-repository telemetry root, while feature_id is read from an index without a filename-safe validator. Pass a validated telemetry root from SddCoderToolkit/configuration, and sanitize or reject feature IDs before constructing artifacts/logs/sdd-coder-usage/<feature>.jsonl.

suggestions.title: Define the same-feature writer policy, not just O_APPEND
suggestions.rationale: Per-feature partitioning removes cross-feature contention, but it does not prevent two MCP server processes from writing the same feature file. Also, concurrent asyncio.to_thread appends should use one pre-serialized line and a single O_APPEND write, not a high-level multi-operation text write. Add either an explicit same-feature lock/ownership rule or an advisory lock, plus a concurrent append test that verifies every line remains valid JSON.

suggestions.title: Capture task size before the worktree disappears
suggestions.rationale: The proposed analysis derives buckets by rereading task markdown, but parse_task_files() consumes files under the feature worktree and /sdd-done removes that worktree. A durable row containing only task_id/task_file cannot reproduce the bucket later. Compute and persist the numeric declared-file count, plus a known/unknown flag, at attempt time while the task file is available.

suggestions.title: Record the resolved model, not only roster configuration
suggestions.rationale: AttemptTelemetryCollector.record() uses seat.model from RosterSeat, while LLMCodeDispatcher resolves the effective model from the profile/client. Fallbacks, provider-qualified aliases, or client defaults can make those values differ, causing the seat/model analysis to attribute usage to the wrong model. Return or expose the resolved model and stamp it into the attempt row and terminal payload.

suggestions.title: Add an end-to-end shadow-scope contract test
suggestions.rationale: Existing dispatcher tests use a fake client without budget hooks, while Mantle budget tests exercise _chat_completion_budgeted() directly. Add a dispatcher-level fake budget client test covering opt-in/off behavior, every turn sharing one root scope, exact max_tokens preservation, report estimate/provider fields, failed-attempt partial usage, and telemetry failures not changing the dispatch result.
